verses.text: Yerusalem-a kumpipa David’ tapa Qoheleth’ kammalte ahi hi.
Qoheleth in, ‘A mawknapi, a mawkna pi, na khempeuh a mawknapi,’ a ci hi.
Nisa nuai-ah tomno nuntak sungin buaina leh haksapi-in a sepna khempeuh ah mihing in a lahkhiat ding bang nei ahi hiam?
Khang khat bei-in khang khat hong khang a, ahi zongin leitung kibang niloh hi.
Ni zong hong suakin tumkik a, tua ciangin a suahna mun ah nawh takin a paikik hi.
Leitaw lam manawh-in huih nungin, tua ciangin leilu lamah kiheikik a, a zuih na ngei teng mah zui-in nungkik zel maipai zelin a kipeipei niloh hi.
Gun khempeuh tuipi sungah luangsuak hi; tua hi napi-in tuipi cikmah-in dim lo hi; gunte a luankhiatna mun ah, tuite paikik a, a luangkik zel dingin a tawp thei loin a kipankik zel hi.
Na khempeuh lunggim huai a, mihing genzawh ding hi lo hi. Mittang in a mong dong mu ngei peuhmah lo a, bil in a tawpna za ngei peuhmah lo hi.
A omsa mah bangin hong piangkik ding a, a kisemsa bangin hong kisemkik ding hi. Nisa nuai ah bangmah a thak bangmah om lo hi.
“En un! Hih in a thak hi” a kici thei ding khatpeuh om ahi hiam? Eite’ khan ma-in a om ngeisa vive ahi hi.
A beisa huna khangmite kiphawk nawn lo hi; tua ahih ciangin a piang lai ding khangmite, amau khita a piang ding khangmite in phawk lo ding uh hi.
Keimah, Qoheleth, Yerusalem ah Israyl-te’ kumpipa ka hi hi.
Vanpi nuai-a a kisem khempeuh keimah in ka lungsim tawh kanin, pilna tawh ka sittel hi—Yahweh in mihing suante tunga a guat a gentheih huai nasep hi a, tua ahih ciangin tua in amaute thuaksak hi.
Nisa nuai-a a kisem nasepte khempeuh ka mukhin a, a vekpi-in a mawknapi taktak leh lungsim buaina mai ahi lel hi.
A kawisa peuhmah kimamsak thei lo a, a om lopi a omin kiseh thei lo hi.
Keimah in, “En in, Yerusalem ah keima ma-a om khempeuh sangin thutheihna ngahzaw leh a thutheihna a khangzaw hi. Hi hi, ka lungsim in pilna leh thutheihna tampi ka tuakkhin hi,” ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.
Tua ahih ciangin pilna ka theih nading leh, haina leh mawlna zong theih nadingin ka lungsim ka zang a, hih in lungsim buaina mai ahihna ka theikhia hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh leitung pilnna tampi neihna pen lunggimna hi a, leitung thutheihna a khansemsemna in dahna khangsak hi.

headings.text: A Pilte leh a Haite, a Huntawpna Kibang

verses.text: Ka lungsim ah, “Tu-in hong pai in; nopsakna ah na kibual theih nadingin lungtaina tawh kong ze-et ding hi,” ka ci hi. Ahih hangin a taktakin, hih zong a mawknapi ahi hi.
Nuihna tawh kisai ka thukhupna in: tua in haina ahi hi. Lungtaina tawh kisai ka thukhupna in: Tua in bang tangtun ahi hiam?

Mihingte in vanpi nuai-ah a nuntak sung tawntungun bang sem leh phattuamna om ding hiam cih ka khentel theih matengin keimah in leenggahzu tawh ka pumpi nopsak theih nadingin ka lungsim ka geel a, haitatna ah ka khut ka zang hi; tua laitak mahin pilna tawh ka lungsim ka uk hi.
Na lianpite ah vaipuak ka la hi. Kei aa dingin inn tampi ka lam a, kei aa ding mahin leenggui lo ka bawl hi.
Kei aa dingin huante leh singgah huante ka bawl a, a sungah singkung gah namtuite khempeuh ka suan hi.
Tua singnote tui piak nadingin tuikhukpi khat ka lam hi.
Ka inn sungsuak nasemte banah sila pasal leh sila numei zong ka lei hi. Hi hi, Yerusalem ah kei ma-a omte khempeuh sangin ganhon leh tuhon neihsa lianpi a tamzaw ka nei hi.
Kham leh ngun, leh kumpite leh gamkete’ neihtuam vilvel vanmanphate zong ka khol hi. Keimah in cilesa nopsakna tawh lasiam numei leh pasal ka cial a, zineu khat khit khat ka la hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yerusalem ah kei ma-a om khempeuh sangin a lianzaw leh a thupizaw ka suak hi. Hih khempeuh ah ka pilna in kei hong ompih hi.

Ka mit in a iplah peuhmah ka nial kei hi. Noptatna khatpeuh panin ka lungsim ka kidek kei hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ka sepna khempeuh ah ka lungnuam a, hih in ka sepna khempeuh panin ka thaman ahi hi.

Tua hi napi-in ka khut-in ka zawhsiangsa nasep khempeuh ka et ciangin gimpi taka ka sepna in a mawknapi hi a, lungsim buaina mai ahi lel hi—hihte khat beek in nisa nuai-ah mihing’ nuntakna ngahsak lo ding hi.
Tua ciangin maitatna leh haina tawh pilna tehkakna lamah ka kihei hi; (Kumpi zaluahpa in ama-a te sangin bang sem theizaw tuan ahi hiam, amah in bang sem tuan ahi hiam?)
Tua ciangin khuavak in khuamial sangin nakpi-in a hoihzawk mah bangin pilna in haina sangin nakpi-in a hoihzawkna ka mu hi.
Mipilpa’ mit a lutang sungah kihong a, ahih hangin mihaite mittaw bangin pai uh hi. Hi hi, a nih tuakun a nuntakna uh ah a kibang khat a tuah ding ka thei hi.

Tua ahih ciangin kei le kei-in, “Kei tunga hong piang thute mah bangin mihaite aa dingin zong a kibang thu mah piang ding ahih nungsangin, a pil ka hihna panin bang metna ngah ka hi hiam?’ ka kici hi. Tua ciangin kei le kei-in, “Hi zong a mawknapi mah ahi hi,” ka kici hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh mipilte a kiphawkna sawtpi khom lo a, mihaite aa sawt lozaw lai hi; hong tung ding hun ah a nih tuakun kimanggilh ding hi. Tua hi a, mipilte bangci sih ahi hiam? Mihaite mah bangin a si uh hi!
Tua ahih ciangin nisa nuai-a a kisem nasepna in kei aa dingin dahna ahihna hang, a vekpi-in a mawknapi ahihna hang leh lungsim buaina mai ahihna hangin nuntakna ka mudah ta hi.
Hi hi, nisa nuai-a ka vaipuaklak nasemte khempeuh ka mudah ta hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate in kei hong laih dingte ka nusiat ding ahi lel hi.
Kua in amah a pil ahih lam ahih keileh a hai ahih lam thei ding ahi hiam? Tua hi napi-in nisa nuai-a pilna tawh gimpi-a ka sepnate khempeuh amah in uk lel ding hi. Hih zong a mawknapi ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nisa nuai-ah haksapi-in ka septe khempeuh panin ka lungkiat ding kipan hi.
Mi khat in pilna, thutheihna, siamna tawh nasem thei ahih nungsangin tuate a sem lo mipa tungah tua teng a ap pelmawh ding hi zenzen hi. Hih zong a mawknapi leh siatna lianpi ahi hi.
Mihing in ama thalawhna thaman, ama lunghihmawhna khempeuh thaman leh nisa nua-a haksapi-a sepna thaman-in bang ngah ahi hiam?
Ama nuntakna dahna tawh kidim a, ama nasepna khasiatna tawh kidim hi. Hi hi, zan nangawnin a lungsim tawlnga lo hi. Hih zong a mawknapi mah ahi hi.
A nasepna ah lungnopna la-in, an ne, tui awnin a om ding sangin mihing aa dingin a hoihzaw om lo hi—hih zong Yahweh khut panin hong pai ahihna ka mu hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Amah tawh loin kua in an ne tui dawnin lungdamna mu thei ding ahi hiam?

Yahweh in Ama mit ah a thutang mi tungah pilna, thutheihna leh lungnopna pia hi; ahih hangin mi mawhte tungah Amah in nasepna bek pia hi; tua ahih ciangin Yahweh’ mai-ah a thutang mipa tungah a piak dingin amah in kaikhawmin khol hi. Hih zong a mawknapi leh lungsim buaina mai ahi lel hi.

headings.text: Na Khempeuh in Hun Nei Ciat
Pumpi Deihna A Ki-uksak Mi pen a Sithei Anhing tawh Kibang

verses.text: Na khempeuh aa dingin hun khat ciat om a, vanpi nuai-ah ngimna khempeuh aa dingin hun khat om hi:
Suah ding hun, sih ding hun, suan ding hun, a kisuansate zunglot ding hun;
thah ding hun, damsak ding hun, sukzan ding hun, lam ding hun;
kah ding hun, nuih ding hun, thuum ding hun, laam ding hun;
suangteng lotkhiat ding hun, suangteng kaihkhop ding hun; angkawi ding hun, kawi nuam lo-a pelh ding hun;
ngah ding hun, sup ding hun; kep ding hun, paihkhiat ding hun;
balkek ding hun, khui ding hun; daih ding hun, pau ding hun;
it ding hun, muhdah ding hun; galdo hun, kilem hun a om hi.
Nasempa in ama nasepna panin bang metna ngah ahi hiam?
Yahweh in mihing’ suante tungah a piak nasepna ka mu khin a, tua in amaute a gawt nading ahi hi.

Amah in na khempeuh a hun ciat ah a hoih-in a bawlkhin a, ahih hangin Yahweh in a patna panin a tawpna dong a bawl nasep, mihingte in a muhkhiat loh nadingin Amah in amau lungsim ah leitung zong koihzo hi.
Mihingte a nuntak sungin a man-in gamtat ding leh nuamsa-in a om ding sangin amau aa dingin a hoihzaw bangmah a om lohna ka thei hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh mi khempeuh in ne-in a dawn zawh ciangin, a sepna khempeuh ah lungkimna tawh nuamsa ding hi—hih in Yahweh kiang panin letsong ahi hih.
Yahweh in a sep peuhmah tawntung ding ahihna ka thei hi; bangmah behlap theih ding hi lo a, bangmah paihkhiat theih ding zong hilo hi. Yahweh in sem a, mihingte in Amah zahtakna pia ding hi.
A om ngeisate tu-in om a, a om lai dingte, a om ngei khinsa ahi hi. Yahweh in a beisa-a pianziate mah omsak kik ding hi.
Nisa nuai-a mihing’ nuntakna thu ka muh a dang khat in: Thutang a kimuh nading mun ah, gitlohna om a, thumaanna a kimuh nading mun ah tatsiatna om hi.
Kei le kei-in, “Yahweh in thumaan mite leh migilote uk ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ngimna peuhpeuh leh nasepna peuhpeuh aa dingin hun khat ciat a om hi,” ka kici hi.
Mihing’ suante dinmun tawh kisai-in kei le kei-in ka kicih inah: “Yahweh in mihingte a ze-etna ahang in amaute ganhing bang ahih lelna a phawk theih nading ahi hi.

Mihing’ suante tuahte mah ganhingte in tuak hi—a nih tuakun a kibang khat tuak uh hi: tua in khat si a, a khat zong si hi. Hi hi, amaute khempeuh in a kibang nuntakna hu nei uh hi. A vekpi-in a mawknapi ahih manin mihing in ganhing sangin a tungnun zawkna bangmah om tuan lo hi.
A vekpi-in a kibang mun ah a pai uh hi a, a vekpi-in leivui pan piangin, a vekpi mah-in leivui ah ciahkik ding hi.
Mihing’ kha a tunglam ah kahto hiam, ahih keileh ganhing’ kha a nuailam leitung ah tuaksuk hiam, cih kua in thei ahi hiam?” ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.

Tua ahih ciangin a nasepna ah nuam a sak ding sangin mihing aa dingin a hoihzaw bangmah a om loh lam ka tel hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua in a thaman ahi hi. Ama khit ah bang piang ding cih a muh theih nadingin kua in amah lak thei ding ahi hiam?

headings.text: Nasep Bek in Khiatna Nei Tuanlo

verses.text: Tua khit ciangin nisa nuai-a a kihih kinetniamna khempeuh a ngaihsun tinten hi. A hehnem ding om lo netniamna a thuak mite’ kitui ka mu hi— amaute in a hehnem ding a nei loin, amau a bawlsiate lam ah vangliatna a om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a nungta lai mite sangin a sisate hampha ka sazaw hi.
Amau tenih khat zawzaw sangin a piang nai lo, nisa nuai-a kigamta gitlohnate a mukha lote hoihzaw hi.
Ka lungngai leuleu a, mihing in a sepna leh a hanciamna pen a vengpa a dem zawh nadingin a lunggulhna hang ahihna ka phawkkhia hi. Hih zong a mawknapi leh lungsim buaina mai ahi hi.
Mihaipa in nasem nuam loin a khut zep a, ama pumpi mah a siasak ahi hi; nasep lohna hangin gilkialin a gawng hi.
Gimpi-a sepna tawh lungsim buaina mai ahi lel ding khut nih dim sangin lungnuam takin khut dawh khat sunga om nek ding hoihzaw hi.
Tua khit ciangin keimah ka kihei a, nisa nuai-a a mawknapi gentehna dang khat ka mu hi:

A lungzuang pawl a nei lo, ta ahi a, sanggam ahi zongin a neilo mi khat ka mu hi. Ama nasepna in mong nei lo a, tua hi napi-in ama hauhna tawh lungkim hun nei loin amah in, “Kua aa dinga nasem a, kei le kei lungkim takin omna kipia hoh lo ka hi hiam?” zong ci tuan lo lai hi. Hih zong a mawknapi leh a khasiathuai nuntakna ahi hi.
Khatkia sangin nih hoihzaw hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amau sepna ah a hoihzaw thaman sang ding uh hi.
Khat a puk leh, a khat in a lawm phong ding a, ahih hangin a tuk ciangin khat bek ahipa dahhuai hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah a phong ding kuamah om lo hi.
Nih lumkhawm leh a nih tuakun khualum uh a, ahih hangin khat guak bangci khualum thei ding ahi hiam?
Gal khatpeuh in mi khat guak a ukcip gawpna ah mi nih in ama dona nang ding uh hi; zangthum-a kiheek khauhual tat mengmeng lo hi.
A kihilh thei nawn lo, khang hamin kumpi hai khat hih sangin a pil khinkhian a zawng naupang khat hih ding hoihzaw hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh kumpigam sungah amah a zawngin a suah hangin kumpi a suak dingin thong panin amah a pusuak hi.
Keimah in nisa nuai-a nuntakna a nei khempeuh, ama kumpi-tokhom a luah ding khangno nihna kiimkot ah a kikaihkhopna ka en hi.
Amaute ma-a mite simzawh lohin tam a, tua hinapi-in amau khita piangte in amah pawkin a lungdam khat beek om lo hi. Hih zong a mawknapi leh lungsim buaina mai ahi lel hi.

headings.text: Hauhnate tawh kisai Ngaihsutzia a Man leh a Khial

verses.text: Yahweh’ Inn ah na pai ciangin kidawmin gamta inla, mihaite’ biakpiakna bangin na piak ding sangin thu ngai dingin kigingzaw in; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in amaute in siatna a bawl lam nangawn uh kiphawk lo uh hi.
Yahweh mai-ah ngaihsun lo pi-in pau gawp kei inla, na kam tawh gen nuam lua-in kinawh gawp kei in. Vantung ah Yahweh om a, leitung ah nang na om hi; tua ahih ciangin na kam tawmsak in.
Nasem tamluatna hangin mangmatna om piang a, kam tampi pau-na hangin mihaite’ haina kilang hi.
Yahweh tungah kam na ciam ciangin tangtungsak hak kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in mihaite tungah nuamsa lo hi. Piak dingin na ciam peuhmah pia in!
Na khatpeuh ciamin na piak loh sangin na ciam vet ding hoihzaw hi.

Na kam hangin na pumpi a mawh suaksak kha kei in; Yahweh’ vangtungmi; malak omna ah pau kei in: Khialhna ahi hi. Bang hangin na kampau-na hangin Yahweh hehsakin, na khutin na sepna susiasak ding na hi hiam?
Mangmatna tampi leh kammal hawmpite pen a mawkna taktak ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh zahtak ziau in!

Mizawngte a kibawlsiatna na muh a, gam sungah thukhenna leh thutang a kiheikhiatna na muh leh, hih thu hangin patau kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh ulian khat pen amah sangin a sangzaw khat in en a, amaute tegel tungah a sangzaw dang om lai hi.
Gam sunga piangte mi khempeuh in la a, kumpipa mahmah in zong gam sunga huahna panin a ngah hi.
Sum iplah peuhmah sum tawh a lungkim hun om lo ding hi. Hauha a iplah peuhmah neihsa tawh lungkim hun nei lo ding hi. Hih zong a mawknapi mah ahi hi.
Neihsa a khan ciangin a nete zong khang semsem hi. A neipa aa dingin a mit tawh a muh cih loh buang bang phattuamna om ahi hiam?
Nasempa khat in tawm a ne-a tam a ne zongin a ihmut nuam a, ahih hangin hauh mahmahna in amah tawlngasak lo hi.
Nisa nuai-a ka muhsa siatna lianpi in hih ahi hi—huahna in a neipa tampi sumsak hi.
Tua ciangin geel khialhna hangin a hauhna teng beitum hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in tapa a neih ciangin a khut sungah bangmah a om kei hi.
A nu’ gil sung panin a guaktangin a pai mah bangin a guaktangin a pai ding hi. Amah in a khut tawh a tawi dingin a nasepna panin bangmah a la kei ding hi.
Hih zong a siatna lianpi mah ahi hi: leitung ah a pai bang teekteekin amah in leitung a nusia ding hi. Huih aa ding lelin a thalawhna in bang phattuamna nei ahi hiam?
A nuntak sung tawntungin amah in khuamial sungah, dahsa, lungzuangsa leh hehsa-in a an ne hi.

Tua ciangin hih thukhupna ka tun hi: Mi khempeuh in Yahweh’ piaksa ama nuntak sung tawntung nisa nuai-ah gimpi-a a sepna gahte ne-in dawnin nuam a sak ding pen a hoih a kilawm ahi hi; bang hang hiam cihleh hih in ama thaman ahi hi.
Tua tham loin Yahweh in hauhnate leh neihsate a piak, tuate nuamtakin a zatsak, ama tanh a ngahsak, a nasepna ah nopsakna a piak mi khempeuh tungah hih in Yahweh kiang pana letsong ahi hi;
Amah in a nuntak hun a tomzia tam ngaihsut lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in a lungsim sungah nopsakna tengsak hi.

headings.text: Nuntakna in a Kisehsa leh a Kitheisa

verses.text: Nitang nuai-ah ka muh ngei siatna khat om a, mite lakah kizel pha mahmah hi:

Yahweh in mi khat huahna, lawhcinna leh pahtawina pia a, tua ahih ciangin amah in mi khatpeuh lunggulh khatpeuh a neih loh om lo hi—ahih hangin Yahweh in tuate nopsakna ngahsak lo hi. Tua tangin mi dangpi khat in nuamsak lawh hi. Hih zong a mawknapi leh a dahhuai thuakna khat ahi hi.

Pasal khat in ta zakhat bang nei-in kum tampi nungta thei hi; bang tanvei a nungta phial zongin a thuphate a nopsakpih kei a, a kivui ding banga a kivui kei leh, amah sangin a sisa-a suak naugek khat hoihzaw lai ka sa hi.
A mawknapi-in pai-in khuamial ah a ciah hang, ama min khuamial in a khuhcip hang,
nitang mu kha ngei loin, thu khatpeuh a theih loh hangin tua mipa sangin tawldamna a neizaw hi—
Amah kum tul nihvei val bang a nuntak phial hangin, a thuphate a nopsakpih kei hi. A vekun a paina mun uh kibang hilo ahi hiam?
Mi khat in gimpi-a a sepna khempeuh a kam aa ding hi lel a, ahih hangin a an duhna lungsim kam ngei lo hi.
Mihaite sangin mipilte in bang neizaw tuan ahi hiam? Midangte mai-ah a omzia ding a theihna bek ahi hi.
Lunggulhna teng delh kawikawi sangin na muh theih teng na neihna hoihzaw hi. Hih zong a mawknapi leh lungsim buaina mai ahi lel hi.
A piangsa peuhmah min a kivawhsa ahihna leh mihing bang hiam cih a kitheisa ahi hi; amah sangin a thahatzaw Amah tawh a kinial zo kei ding hi.
Thu tam semsem leh, khiatna nei lo semsem hi. Tua in mi khatpeuh bangci phattuamsak ahi hiam?

Bang hang hiam cihleh khiatna nei lo tomkha sung ama nuntakna niliim bangin a paizanzan nuntakna sungah mihing aa dingin a man thu a thei kua ahi hiam? Nisa nuai-ah ama nungah a piang ding thu kua in genthei ahi hiam? A piang na khempeuh pen Yahweh bek in a sehsa leh a theihsa ahi hi. Mihing in mailam thu ding genkhol thei lo a, ahi zongin mihing zuih ding lampi Yahweh’ Lai Siangtho sungah kikoih hi.
Paknamtui hoihpen sangin minpha hoihzaw hi; suahni sangin sihni hoihzaw hi.

Pawi bawlte’ inn ah pai sangin a dah a kapte’ inn ah paina hoihzaw hi; bang hang hiam cihleh sihna in mi khempeuh aa dingin a tawpna ahi hi; Tua ahih ciangin a nungtate in a lungtang ah limtakin a ciapteh ding ahi hi.
Nuihna sangin dahna hoihzaw hi; lungsim aa dingin dah mai hoihzaw hi.
Mipilte’ lungsim pen a dah a kapte’ inn ah om a, ahih hangin mihaite’ lungsim ahih leh nopsakna inn ah a om hi.
Mihaite’ lasakna ngaih ding sangin mipilte’ taii-na ngaih ding mihing aa dingin hoihzaw hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh mihai khat nuihna pen beel nuai-a lingkung puakzaizai tawh kibang hi. Hih zong a mawknapi mah ahi hi.
Bawlsiatna in mipil khat a kam cipsak a, sumgolh in mihing lungsim siasak hi.
Na khatpeuh a kipatna sangin a tawpna hoihzaw a, lungsim kiphatsakna sangin lungduaina hoihzaw hi.
Heh pahpah kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh mihaite’ ang sungah hehna teng hi.
“Bang hangin hihte sangin tanglai hunte hoihzaw ai tam?” ci kei in. Tua bang dotna na dotna hangin pilna a lakkhia na hi kei hi.
Gamh mah bangin pilna neih ding a hoih hi a; tua in nitang a mu mite phatuamsak hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh sum in kidalna khat ahih mah bangin pilna zong kidalna khat ahi hi; thutheihna pan i metna pen pilna in amah a nei mite tungah nuntakna a pia hi.
Yahweh’ nasepsate ngaihsun un: Amah in a kawisaksate kua in tangsak thei ding ahih hiam?

Thu hoih a pian ciangin lungdam in; ahih hangin hun a siat ciangin, ‘Yahweh in khat bawl-a adang khat zong bawl hi,’ ci-in ngaihsun in; mihing in ama mai-ah a kikoihkholte a theikhol peuhmah kei ding hi.
Tomno ka nuntak sungin na khempeuh ka mukhin hi—thutang mi khat a thumaan hangin kisia a, migilo khat a gitloh hangin a a khansau hi.
Thumaan khengval kei inla, kipilsak lua kei in. Bang hangin nang le nang kisusia ding na hi hiam?
Zong gilo kei inla, haitat kei in. Bang hangin na hun tung nai lopi-in si ding na hi hiam?
A khat lencipin adang khat zong khah tuan loh ding hoih hi. Yahweh a zahtak mipa tua uangtatna tenih panin suakta ding hi.
Pilna in khuapi sunga gam-uk sawm sangin mipil khat thahatsakzaw ding hi.
Ahih hangin hun khempeuh ah hoihna bekbek a sem, a mawh ngei lo, leitung ah thutang mi khat zong om lo hi.
Mi thugen peuhpeuh zong thudon khin pahpah kei in; tua bang hi keileh na nasempa hong samsiatna na za kha ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh na theihsa mah bangin nang mahmah in zong tamveipi midangte na samsiat khin hi.
Hihte khempeuh pilna tawh ka sittelsa ahi hi. Keimah in, “Ka pil ding hi,” ka ci hi; ahih hangin kei kiang panin na gamla hi.
Tua in gamla mahmah-in thuk tawpin thuk ahih manin kua in mu zo ding ahi hiam?

Tua ahih ciangin mihaite’ gitlohna, pilvang lohna, navak lohna teng a khiatna tuamtuam tawh ka lakkhiat theih nadingin a khiatna leh pilna theih ding, kantel ding leh a zongkhia dingin ka lungsim ka hei hi.

Kei tungah sihna sangin a khazaw thu in numei tawh kisai ka thuahkhak thu hi a, amau ngaihsutnate in thangzak leh ngenthang hi a, amau khutte in sikkol ahi hi. Yahweh a lungkimsak mipa tuanu kiang panin suakta ding a, ahih hangin mawhneipa ahih leh tuanu matsa-in om ding hi.
Qoheleth in, ‘Ka muh khiat hiteng ahi hi: a deihna bulpi muhzawh nadingin thu khat tungah adang khat ka gawm a,
ka zonzon lai a, ahih hangin ka mu tuan nawn kei hi. Pasal tulkhat panin pasal khat bang a pil dingin ka mu a, ahih hangin a pil numei khat zong ka mu kei hi.
Ahi zongin hih thu bek ka mu hi: Yahweh in a thutang dingin mite bawlkhin a, ahih hangin amaute in amau nathak bawlna lamah lunglut takin kiheikhin uh hi.
Mipilpa tawh a kibang kua ahi hiam? Na khiatna taktak a thei kua ahi hiam? Mihing a pilna in a maitang tangsak a, a maigum teng khelsak hi.
Yahweh tungah na kiciamna na khualna-un kumpipa’ thupiakna zui un.
Ama omna mun panin paikhia baih kei in. Amah in a lungkimna bangbangin hih thei ahih manin thusia lamah pang kei in.
Kumpipa’ thu a omna ah vangliatna om ahih manin kua in ama kiangah, “A bangci gamtat na hiam?” ci ngam ding ahi hiam?
Thupiakna a zui peuhmah in siatna tuakkha lo ding uh a, mipilpa’ lungsim in a hun leh thukhenna a nih tuakin khentel thei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh mi khat a gentheihna ama tungah a gik mahmah hangin na khempeuh ah a tuam vilvel hun leh a paizia om hi.
Amah in a mailam hun ding thei lo ahih nungsangin bang piang ding hiam cih kua in gen thei ding ahi hiam?
Kuamah in huih a uk theih loh mah bangin kuamah in ama sih ni uk thei lo hi. Galkido sungin kuamah a kikhawlsak loh mah bangin gitlohna in gitlohna a gamta mite khah lo ding hi.
Hihte khempeuh ka mukhin a, nitang nuai-a a kisem nasep peuhmah ka ngaihsun hi. A kisehsa hun khat om a, tua hun sungah mi khat in adang mi khat a natsak nading vangliatna a nei hi.
Migilote si-in a kivui ka mu hi. Amaute a han uh ah kipaipih a, amaute a gitloh gamtat ngitngetna uh khuapi sung nangawn ah kiphat veve hi. Hih zong a mawknapi ahi hi.
Mawhna thukhenna khat manlangin a kithukhen loh ciangin, mihing’ suante lungsim in siatna bawl ding sawm uh hi.
Mi mawh khat in zavei bang siatna bawl napi-in, a nuntaksau veve hi; Yahweh mai-ah zahtakna a piate, Yahweh a zahtak mite tawh thu khempeuh a lem ding lam ka thei hi.
Ahih hangin a gilo mi aa dingin thu nuam lo ding a, niliim a bang ama nuntak ni zong sau lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Yahweh a zahtak kei hi.
Leitung ah a mawknapi adang pawlkhat om lai hi: migilote’ ngah dinga kilawmte, thutang mite in ngah a, thumaan mite ngah dinga kilawmte, migilote’n ngah hi. Hih zong a mawknapi hi, ka ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin nitang nuai-a mihing aa dingin ne-in dawnin nopsak ding sangin a hoihzaw bangmah omlo ahih manin nuntak sung nuamsa-a om ding hoih ka sa hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in nitang nuai-ah ama tungah a piak a nuntak sung khempeuh-in a nasepna ah nopsakna in amah pawlpih ding hi.
Sun leh zanin khawl ngei loin nitang nuai-a mihingte’ nasepnate ka muhtel theih nading leh pilna ka theih nadingin ka lungsim ka saan ciangin,

Yahweh’ sepsa nasep khempeuh ka mu hi. Nitang nuai-ah a piang hih in bang hiam cih mihing in telzo lo ding hi; Mihing deih takin hahkatin a kankhiat hangin mu lo ding hi. Mipil khat in ka theih hi a cih phial leh zong, a vekin a mukim kei ding hi.

Tua ahih ciangin hih thu khempeuh ka ngaihsun a, hih thukhupna ka tun hi: thumaan mi leh mi pil in a sepna khempeuh pen Yahweh’ khut sungah om hi. Kuamah in amah a ngak itna hiam, muhdahna hiam cih a thei kei hi; tuate khempeuh ama mai-ah om hi.

Ahih hangin mi khempeuh tungah a tung thupiang khat om hi. Hih thu in thumaante leh migilote tung, a dikte leh a siate tung, a siangte leh a sianglote tung, biakpiakna a piate tung leh a pia lote tungah thumaan mipa tungah a tun mah bangin mimawhte tungah zong tung a, thuciam a bawl mite tungah a tun mah bangin a bawl ngam lo mite tungah zong a kibangin tung kim hi.

Hih in nitang nuai-a na khempeuh sungah thusia ahi hi; hih thu khat in mi khempeuh tungah a tung hi! Hi hi, mihing’ lungsim siatna dim a, a nuntak sungun a lungtang uh ah haina om hi. A nuntak kim khit uh ciangin, a vekpi-un a si uh hi.
Ahih hangin a nungta khempeuh tawh a kipawlpa aa dingin lametna om hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a si humpinelkai sangin a hing ui khat hoihzaw hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh a nungtate in a sih ding lam uh thei a, ahih hangin a sisate in bangmah a thei kei uh hi. A sisate in thaman bangmah nei nawn lo uh a, amaute a kiphawkna nangawn zong kimangngilh ta hi.
A itna, a muhdahna leh a enna teng uh zong maimang khin hi; nitang nuai-a a piang peuhmah bangmah a tangkha nawn kei ding uh hi.
Yahweh in na nasepnate hong sang ahih manin na lampi ah pai-in, lungnopna tawh na an ne inla, lungtai takin na leenggahzu dawn in.
Na puante pak den henla, na lu sathau tawh kipelh kei hen.

Yahweh in nang hong piak sunni nuai ah a mawknapi na nuntak hun sung, a mawknapi na hun khempeuh, na it na zi tawh a nuam theithei-in om in. Bang hang hiam cihleh hih in na nuntak sung leh sunni nuai-ah haksapi-a na nasepna ah na lawhtak ahi hi.
Na sep ding peuhmah na hatna khempeuh tawh sem in; bang hang hiam cihleh na pai nading hankhuk ah nasep ahi a, geelna ahi a, thutheihna ahi a, pilna ahi zongin om lo hi.

Khatvei ka kihei beh lai a, sunni nuai-ah adang ka mu lai hi: a manlang khempeuh in tai kidemna zo tawntung lo a, a thahat khempeuh in gal zo tawntung lo a, a pilte in an a kham ngah tawntung lo a, thutheitel mi khempeuh in huahna ngah tawntung lo a, a siam mi khempeuh in pahtawina ngah tawntung lo hi; ahih hangin amaute khat ciat tungah hun hoih hunpha a tung hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh mihing in ama hun ding thei lo hi. Ngen muanhuai ah ngasa a awk bangin, thangzak ah vasa a awk bangin amaute tungah thakhatin siatna a tun ciangin hun sia ah mihing’ tapate a awk hi.
Sunni nuai-ah hih pilna thu gentehna zong ka mukhin a, tua in ka lungsim hong khoih mahmah hi:
Khatvei lai-in mi tawmno a tenna khuapi neu khat om a, kumpi lian khat kuanin tua khuapi umcih a, a kiimkot ah umcihna panmunte a lamsak hi.
Tu-in a zawng mipil khat hih khuapi sungah kimu a, ama pilna tungtawnin khuapi suakta hi. Tua hi napi-in kuamah in tua mizawngpa phawk lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mizawngpa’ pilna kisimmawh-in, ama kammalte a kithusim sak loh hangin, keimah in, “Thahatna sangin pilna hoihzaw hi,” ka ci hi.
Mihaite’ kumpipa’ otna sangin mipilpa in dam taka a gen hiat-hiat thute kithudonzaw ding hi.
Galvante sangin pilna hoihzaw a, ahih hangin mimawh khat in mi hoih tampi susia hi.
Pilna leh pahtawina a ngah mipa tungah haina tawmno khat sepkhakna pen misi tho in paknamtui sathau namsia a sak tawh kibang linlian hi.
Mipilpa a lungsim in a khut taklam ah amah hei a, ahih hangin mihaipa a lungsim in a veilam ah amah hei hi.
Hi hi, mihaipa lampi ah a pai ciang nangawn-in kingaihsun loin mi khempeuh tungah a haina a tangkoko hi.
Nangma tungah gam-ukpa hong heh leh, lehdo dingin na omna taisan kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh kipumpiakna in hehsakna lianpi daisak hi.
Sunni nuai-ah ka muh siatna leh gam-ukte kiang pana khialhna a om hi.
Mihaite thupi takin kikoih-in, a pil mahmah-te a kiniamkoih hi.
A pil pente leitung ah sila bangin a pai laitakin silate sakol tungah a tuanna ka mu hi.
Mi dangte thangsiahna-in dum a to mipa tua sung mah ah kia ding hi. Kulh a vutlet peuhmah gul in tu ding hi.
Suang to khiate suang mah in nasak ding a, singphukte sing mah in lauhuaina pia ding hi.
Heitang mawl-in, mipa in a tathiam kei leh, tha tam a sanzawk kul hi; tua ahih ciangin pil zawkna in gualzawh zawkna tun ding hi.
Gul a kikhim kei leh tu taktak ding a, mi gensiate tawh kilamdanna om lo hi.
Mipilpa a kam pana kammalte in pahtawina ngahsak ding a, ahih hangin mihaipa’ muk in amahmah nawmvalh ding hi.
A kam pana kammal, haina tawh kipan pah a, a thugen tawpna zong navak lohna tawh a khup uh hi.
Mihaite in thu genzak gawp uh a, ahih hangin mihing in a piang ding thu a gen thei kei hi. Ama nung ah bang piang ding ahi hiam? Ama tungah kua in gen thei ding ahi hiam?
Mihaite in khuapi paina lampi nangawn a muh nawn loh liang nadingun a nasepna un amaute nakpi takin a gimsak hi.
Naupang khat kumpi-in nei-in, zingsanga pawi a bawl gam-uk a nei gam aw, a dahhuai taktak na hi hi.
Nampi sungsuak tapa khat kumpi-in nei-in, zukham gawp nading hi loin, hatna dingin a kilawm hunin an a ne gam-uk a nei gam aw, thupha ngah na hi hi.
Thadahna hangin inn muat a, a ommawk lua khut hangin inn keh hi.
Nuih nadingin pawl kibawl a, nuntak nopsak nadingin leenggahzu kibawl hi; ahih hangin na khempeuh aa dingin sum kibawl hi.

Na lungsim sung nangawn panin kumpipa samsia kei in; na lupna inndei sung nangawn panin mihaute samsia kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh huihlak vasa khatpeuh in na aw puak thei a, kha a nei khatpeuh in na gen peuhmah na genkik kha ding hi.

headings.text: Na Khangno Lai-in Yahweh Zong In

verses.text: Tuite tungah na anlum lawn in; bang hang hiam cihleh ni tampi khat ciangin na mukik ding hi.
Leitung ah bang siatna tung ding hiam cih thei lo na hih ciangin khen sagih khen giat suahin pia in.
Meiite guah tawh a kidim leh, leitung ah amau le amau a kihawmsak kik zel uh hi; leitaw lam ahih keileh leilu lamah singkung a puk leh, a pukna mun ah lup nading mun om hi.
Huih a vilvil mipa in bangmah vawh lo ding a, meiite a kai-etet mipa in an la lo ding hi.
Nupi gai khat sunga guhte ah nuntakna bangci tun hiam cih na theih loh bang teekteekin, Yahweh nasepsa khempeuh bangci sep hiam cih na thei kei ding hi.

Zingsangin na khaici vawh inla, nitakin zong na khut omkhongsak kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh hih ahih keileh hua koizaw a hoihin hong piang ding hiam cih na thei kei a, a nih tuakin zong a lem ding hiam cih na thei kei hi.
Khuavak khum takpi a, nivang-tang et ding pen mit aa dingin a lungkim huai khat ahi hi.
Hi hi, mi khat kum tampi a nuntak leh, khua phat ni simin nuamsa hen; ahih hangin a mial nite zong phawk tahen; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate tam mahmah ding hi. A piang na khempeuh a mawknapi ahi hi.

Khangnote aw, na khangno lai-un nuamsa un. Na khangno lai-un na lungsim uh nuamsak un. Na ut bangbangin gamta unla, hoih nasak bangun om un. Ahih hangin hihte khempeuh tawh kizui-in Yahweh in thu hong khen ding lam phawk gige un.
Tua ahih ciangin na lungtang panun na langdona uh hemkhia unla, na cilesa panun siatna hemkhia un; bang hang hiam cihleh na naupangna uh leh na khangnona uh a mawknapi ahi hi.
Lungkham hun hong tun ma, ‘Nuntakna nuamsa kei ing,’ na cih ding hun hong tun ma, na khangno lai-in nang hong Piangsakpa phawk in.
Nitang, khuavak, khapi, aksite a mial ma, meiite in guah tawpna a zuksak ma-in Piangsakpa Phawk in.
Tua ni-in inncingte a liin ciang, mi thahatte a maikun ciang, angawite tawm lua uh ahih manin a khawl uh ciang, tawlet ah a dakte in khuamial a muh uh ciang,
kongzing laka kongkhakte a kikhak ciang, angawina ging a daih ciang, vasa ham-in mite a dintoh zawh nawn loh ciang, tumging’ tanute khempeuh a daih ciang,

a sang panin lauhuaina leh lampi ah lipkhaphuaina hangin amaute a lau uh ciang, almond kungte paakin, kauphe vangikpi hong hi-in, lunggulhna a pian loh ciang, tua ni ciangin mihing in ama tawntung inn zuan a, a thuumte kongzing lakah pai kawikawi uh hi.
Ngun khauhual a kitah ma, kham kuang-uk a kitap ma, tuikhuk ah tuibeel a kitapzan ma, tuibeem-a tuikaihna pei a kitamzan ma-in nang hong Piangsakpa phawk in;
Leivui in ama paina leitung ah ciahkik ding a, kha ahih leh a piapa Yahweh kaingah ciahkik ding hi.
Qoheleth in, “A mawknapi, a mawknapi! Na khempeuh a mawknapi hi,” a ci hi.
Amah mahmah mipil a hih banah Qoheleth in mite thutheihna a hilh hi. Hi hi, amah in ngaihsunsun-in, kantelin, paunak tampitak a banbanin a gual hi.
Qoheleth in a lungdam huai kammalte leh thutang takin a kigelh thuman kammalte a kantel hi.
Mipilte’ thugente in ciangtawn zum tawh kibang a, siate’ khop nasepte in a kikhenkip siktukilhte tawh kibang a, Tuucing Khat piak ahi hi.
Ahih hangin ka tapa aw, Tuucingpa Khat piak kammalte sangin khengvalzaw-in paikhak ding kidawm in. Laibu tampi bawlna in mong nei lo a, tampi sin luatna in pumpi gimsak hi.
Hih thu buppi a thukhupna ngai ni: Yahweh’ Thukhamte zuihna tawh Amah zahtak in; bang hang hiam cihleh hih in mihing’ tavuan bulpi ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh a kihih simte-a kipan, a sia hitaleh a pha hitaleh, i hihna khempeuh ah Yahweh in thu hong khen ding hi.
